summary: This 8-K filed by NexGel, Inc. reports the appointment of Brian J. Kieser and Kevin M. Harris to its board of directors alongside the issuance of convertible notes and warrants to Kieser. Kieser was issued a $1M convertible promissory note at $0.60/share (1,666,667 shares) and a warrant for 833,334 shares at $0.80/share, mirroring terms from an earlier $5.5M financing with Sequence LifeScience Inc. The appointments appear routine, not forced departures. The transactions reflect capital-raising rather than a special situation. There is no merger, tender offer, or activist campaign disclosed. The filing does not constitute an acquisition or divestiture by the company.
